verse.text: Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself. Each day has enough trouble of its own.

reflection.scripture: Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself. Each day has enough trouble of its own.
reflection.observation: Jesus speaks directly to our tendency to spiral into future anxiety. He doesn't minimize life's troubles—He acknowledges each day has enough of its own. The invitation is to stay present, trusting God with what we cannot see or control.
reflection.application: When I feel the weight of 'what if' today, I will pause and name one thing I can trust God with right now. I'll set a reminder mid-day to breathe and recenter on today's provision rather than tomorrow's uncertainty.
reflection.prayer: Lord, You know the worries I carry before I speak them. Help me release tomorrow into Your hands. Give me grace for today's troubles and eyes to see Your provision in this moment. Amen.
